result.summary: The page is mostly intact. The main defect is the top-right profile/notification button, which shows only a red dot and no icon or avatar. The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail is also styled inconsistently with the other cards.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right header is an empty light-gray circle with only a red notification dot. Its icon or avatar image appears to have failed to load, so users can't tell what the control does.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the avatar image or icon renders. Add a fallback, such as user initials or a default person or bell icon, for when the image fails to load. Also give the button an accessible label.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a pale, washed-out background. The other cards use dark, rich backgrounds. The plate is also off-center and partly covered by the time badge, so the image looks badly cropped.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment across the carousel (matching background tone, cropping and focal point). Keep the dish clearly visible and not obscured by the time badge.
